correctness.rationale: The original RESULT.md contains a false numerical inequality 1+ab >= (a+1)+(b+1)-1 for arbitrary a,b (a=b=1 is a counterexample), so it cannot stand unchanged as a valid proof of the minimum. The fully staged replacement RESULT.md repairs the minimum proof: if subtrees have i and m-1-i keys, a>=i+1 and b>=m-i by induction, whence 1+ab>=1+(i+1)(m-i)=m+1+i(m-1-i)>=m+1, with equality exactly at an endpoint root and minimum nonempty subtree (m>=2), giving 2^(m-1) minimizers. The original componentwise commuting criterion, uniqueness of root, and product recursion are structurally checked against Demazure-idempotent classification; independent recursive size arithmetic gives f4(5)=8, f4(6)=2, f4(7)=4. The corrected final claim holds for every m>=1, with finite rank tests as checks not proofs.

value.rationale: Classifying maximal pairwise commuting idempotent sets (not maximal commutative monoid subalgebras) by labeled binary search trees yields a complete natural class of semilattices and a nontrivial full size spectrum. The sharp Catalan count, minimum and recurrence have intrinsic algebraic/combinatorial meaning and are not a mere parameter substitution into the distinct Kiselman quotient result. The corrected minimum proof preserves the same valuable classification.
